description: Verify that DUT in ESTABLISHED piggybacks the acknowledgement on a queued data segment when the tester injects ACK+payload that opens the window and provides ack-able data — within 0.5 sec (RFC 793 §3.9 SHOULD)
approach:
[Objective]
When DUT has a data segment to send AND fresh data to ack, an efficient implementation piggybacks the ACK on the outgoing data instead of emitting a pure ACK. RFC 793 §3.9 calls for this within 0.5 s.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. DUT → Tester: first data segment (window full).
3. Before any second segment, tester sends ACK+payload (opens window + provides data).
4. Observation: DUT → Tester: piggyback segment within 500 ms with ack_num covering the tester payload.

[Pass condition]
DUT emits piggyback within 500 ms.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_first_data — DUT did not emit first segment
• Fail_dut_sent_second_segment_before_ack — DUT raced ahead
• Fail_no_piggyback — no piggyback within 500 ms
• Fail_wrong_piggyback_ack — piggyback ack_num does not cover tester payload

verdicts.Pass: DUT piggybacked the ACK on next data segment — normal
verdicts.Fail_dut_sent_second_segment_before_ack: DUT sent second segment before piggyback inject
verdicts.Fail_no_piggyback: No DUT piggyback segment within 500 ms
verdicts.Fail_wrong_piggyback_ack: DUT piggyback ack_num does not acknowledge tester payload
